title: pilosella officinarum subsp. peleteriana
intro: Pilosella officinarum subsp. peleteriana, commonly known as false oxeye daisy or false sowthistle, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and it has been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pilosella officinarum subsp. peleteriana include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
